meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: Claude 能按你的文字描述生成图片,或基于传入的参考图片进行编辑(如换背景、加元素),并把结果保存为 PNG 文件。生成需要配置 OpenRouter API 密钥。涉及技术图表(如流程图、电路图)时,它会改用另一个技能处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成照片、插画、概念图等图像,或对现有图片进行编辑时触发;涉及流程图、电路图等技术图表时,该技能不会接管,而是转用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 帮我画一张夕阳下的山景照片
say.note: 会调用脚本生成图片并保存为 PNG。

say.text: 把这张照片的背景改成蓝色
say.note: 需要提供图片路径,进入编辑模式。

say.text: 用 FLUX 模型画一只太空猫

howto.what_en: Claude can create images from text or edit provided photos via OpenRouter, saving PNG output. Requires an OpenRouter API key. For technical diagrams (flowcharts, circuits), it uses the scientific-schematics skill instead.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests general images (photos, illustrations, concept art) or image editing. Technical diagrams go to the scientific-schematics skill instead.

say_en.text: Draw a photo of mountains at sunset.
say_en.note: Runs the generate-image script and saves a PNG.

say_en.text: Change the background of this photo to blue.
say_en.note: Provide an input image path to enter edit mode.

say_en.text: Draw a space cat using the FLUX model.
